name: Burr Ridge Farmers' Market
tagline: Burr Ridge Market on the Green
description: Burr Ridge Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 450 Village Center Dr., IL. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
